entry.content: ask_pipeworx: description, inputSchema -6,574 +6,900 -1717 +1815 +Optionally pass packs:["slug","slug"] to restrict routing to specific sources ("answer this using THESE packs"); omit it for full-catalog routing. parameters: +input.packs input.packs description: OPTIONAL. Restrict routing to these pack slugs (e.g. ["sec-form-d","sec-13f"]) — the router then picks only from tools in those packs. Omit for the default full-catalog routing. Slugs come from list_packs / search_packs / https://pipeworx.io/directory; unlisted or unknown slugs are ignored and named in _meta.pack_scope.ignored, and if none of them resolves the question is routed across the whole catalog with _meta.pack_scope.full_catalog:true (never an empty answer). ask_pipeworx_beta: description, inputSchema -6,574 +6,900 -A +No -routing prompt (v9-eval-disjoint-examples) -live +active right now (the last was retired -every call here; +outcome evidence 2026-07-26), so this currently matches -serves it to a slice of traffic only. +exactly. parameters: +input.packs input.packs description: OPTIONAL. Restrict routing to these pack slugs (e.g. ["sec-form-d","sec-13f"]) — the router then picks only from tools in those packs. Omit for the default full-catalog routing. Slugs come from list_packs / search_packs / https://pipeworx.io/directory; unlisted or unknown slugs are ignored and named in _meta.pack_scope.ignored, and if none of them resolves the question is routed across the whole catalog with _meta.pack_scope.full_catalog:true (never an empty answer). ask_pipeworx_grounded: description, inputSchema -6,574 +6,900 -1717 +1815 parameters: +input.prefer_tool input.prefer_tool description: Run this exact tool instead of letting the router choose — use a name from a previous answer's alternatives[]. Arguments are still filled from your question. Unknown names are refused, never guessed. company_facts: description, inputSchema -Attributes in v1: +Attributes: -cash. +cash, gross_profit, operating_income, eps_diluted, capex, operating_cash_flow, long_term_debt, shares_outstanding (the dei COVER-PAGE share count, so its period end is the cover date, after the quarter closed — that is the most current count the filing carries). Units are not all USD: shares_outstanding is in `shares` with currency null, eps_diluted in `USD/shares`. A discrete quarter the filer never filed — every Q4, and Q2/Q3 of cash-flow lines, which are filed year-to-date — is DERIVED as YTD(q) minus YTD(q-1) and comes back with `reported: false`, th parameters: -"annual"}}] +"annual"}}, {"attribute": "shares_outstanding", "company": "TSLA", "period": {"fiscal_quarter": 2, "fiscal_year": 2026, "type": "quarterly"}}, {"attribute": "capex", "company": "TSLA", "period": {"fiscal_quarter": 2, "fiscal_year": 2026, "type": "quarterly"}}, {"attribute": "net_income", "company": "TSLA", "period": {"fiscal_quarter": 4, "fiscal_year": 2025, "type": "quarterly"}}] -end. +end; "gross_profit"; "operating_income"; "eps_diluted" (diluted EPS, unit USD/shares, never derived or summed); "capex" (cash paid for PP&E); "operating_cash_flow" (net cash from operating activi deep_research: description -1717 +1815 -6,574 +6,900 entity_profile: description, inputSchema -(LATEST 10-K Revenues + NetIncomeLoss + +(the latest ANNUAL Revenues, NetIncomeLoss, -sorted +diluted EPS, capex and operating cash flow, each with its period_end, SEC form and the accession of the filing it came from — plus EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding, which is the newest COVER-PAGE share count the filer has published rather than an annual one, so its -DESC); +is a cover date after the quarter closed and it is the right per-share denominator; a filer tagging a fallback concept appears under the name of that tag instead, e.g. PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets instead of PaymentsToAcqui parameters: +input.country input.country description: OPTIONAL ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the business register you mean ("NO", "FI", "GB", "JP", "FR", "EE", "BR"). Only affects a NAME lookup, and is often what separates the company you mean from a US namesake. When a name resolves to a register entity with no CIK, the SEC/CIK-keyed sections are reported under `sources_skipped` with reason `not_queried` — they were never asked, which is not the same as having failed. -"Moderna") — names resolve via +"Moderna"). A NAME now resolves through the national business registers as well as -EDGAR company-name match. +E resolve_entity: inputSchema, outputSchema parameters: +input.country input.country description: OPTIONAL ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the country whose business register you mean ("NO", "FI", "JP", "GB", "FR", "EE", "BR"). entry.content: vault_check: outputSchema parameters: +EACH COMPONENT NAMES THE QUANTITY IT READ: `readAs` is the reading, `basis` says which column it came from and `computation` is the arithmetic in words, so a figure here can be re-derived rather than taken on trust and compared with a figure elsewhere rather than merely disagreed with. On the exit component `basis` is `declared-withdrawable` (the venue’s own exit figure, the SAME number `vault_exits.declaredWithdrawableUsd` divides) or `idle-floor` (uninvested cash, a LOWER BOUND used only where the venue publishes no exit figure, and the sentence then begins "at least"). Until 2026-10-17 it vault_exits: outputSchema parameters: +output.exitCap output.exitCap description: THE CONTRACT ASKED DIRECTLY, ON THE VAULTS THAT DECLARE NOTHING. Present only where `declaredWithdrawableUsd` is null, which is where 33 Concrete vaults holding $1.26bn and the ether.fi Liquid vaults sit: a strategy vault deploys its capital rather than holding it, so there is no free balance to read and the venue publishes no withdrawable figure. We call `maxWithdraw` on the LARGEST HOLDER WE KNOW — per owner, so asked about an address holding no shares it answers zero for every vault in existence, which is why it must never be asked of a stranger —

entry.title: remote/ru.krasoft/zakupki 2026-09-23T160903932493 -> 2026-10-17T060431450363: 2 changed
entry.content: search_contract_tech_specs: description, inputSchema -медизделия, +медизделия (miTypeCode — 6-значный код вида по НКМИ, miTypeName, классификация miSection/miSubsection), +Строк выдачи — не больше 200 (10 страниц по 20); для сводной задайте groupBy — итоги по виду МИ, классификации, году или месяцу подписания, владельцу РУ или производителю считаются на сервере по ВСЕЙ выборке и приходят в groups (если строки не нужны — pageSize: 1). parameters: +input.groupBy input.groupBy description: Сводная по всей выборке; в каждой группе key — значение разреза. Разрезы МИ (только позиции МИ): "miType" — по коду вида НКМИ (с его классификацией), "miClassification" — по подразделу классификации, "miSection" — по разделу. "signedYear" / "signedMonth" — ряд по годам или месяцам подписания (key «2026» / «2026-03», группы по времени; если периодов больше groupSize — последние). "regHolder" — владелец РУ (вероятный), "manufacturer" — производитель (вероятный): те же поля, что в BI, считаются по аналитической витрине и не работают со свободным текстом q search_tender_tech_specs: description, inputSchema +У медизделий — вид МИ: miTypeCode (6-значный код по НКМИ), miTypeName и классификация miSection/miSubsection. Строк выдачи — не больше 200 (10 страниц по 20); для сводной задайте groupBy — итоги по виду МИ или классификации считаются на сервере по ВСЕЙ выборке и приходят в groups (если строки не нужны — pageSize: 1). parameters: +input.groupBy input.groupBy description: Сводная по всей выборке; в каждой группе key — значение разреза. Разрезы МИ (только позиции МИ): "miType" — по коду вида НКМИ (с его классификацией), "miClassification" — по подразделу классификации, "miSection" — по разделу. По каждой группе: rows, sum, qty, notifications (оценка, погрешность до 2–3 %); groupsTotal, totalRows/totalSum и otherRows/otherSum — чтобы итог по группам сходился с итогом выборки. Если сводная не посчиталась, причина — в groupsError input.groupBy enum: ["miType", "miClassification", "miSection"] input.groupSize input.groupSize

entry.content: claimhit_generate_chart: description, inputSchema -Requires +SPENDS 1 CHART CREDIT and asks first: the initial call returns -search_id +quote naming the target it matched -target name. +runs nothing, and the chart is generated only when you call again with confirm: true after the user agrees. parameters: +input.confirm input.confirm default: false input.confirm description: Set true only after showing the user the quote from the unconfirmed call and getting their agreement. Without it, nothing is run and nothing is charged. claimhit_get_result: description, inputSchema -full -ID. +ID, and narrow, sort and page through them. FREE and unlimited: every call is a view over results already paid for, so filter and re-read as much as the conversation needs. A search completes in phases: check the returned `status` field and call again if it is RUNNING, because background enrichment keeps finding additional implementers for several minutes after the first results appear. Only present results as final when status is COMPLETE. Results are paged — if the response carries a `more` field, there are further matches and you must not present the page you have as the complet parameters: +input.company input.company description: Only return targets whose company (or standards body) contains this text, case-insensitive. E.g. "Bosch", "Samsung". input.detail input.detail default: "summary" input.detail description: full adds the per-element scores, the evidence source and the stored evidence passages for each target — use it when asked why something scored as it did. Reading evidence is free; a Hit Chart is the paid, element-by-element analysis. input.detail enum: ["summary", "full"] input.include_held_low input.include_held_low description: Also return candidates held back for claimhit_rerun_search: description, inputSchema -results. +results, repeating the inputs that steered it — the company scope, the hint, named products, markets, company sizes and the named standard. +search, 1 search credit after that. Asks first either way: the initial call returns a quote listing the inputs it will repeat and whether it is free, and runs nothing until you call again with confirm: true. To narrow or re-read the results you already have, use claimhit_get_result instead — that is free and does not start a new -Use when the user wants to refresh results or check if new infringers have appeared. parameters: +input.confirm input.confirm default: false input.confirm description: Set true only after showing the user the quote from the unconfirmed call and getting their agreement. Without it, nothing is run and nothing is charged. +input.widen input.widen description: Drop the original company scope and search the whole market. Default false, which repeats the original scope. Use when the first search was scoped to named companies and found too little. added claimhit_refine_product

entry.content: vizier_verify_action: description +Call vizier_verify_action immediately before an AI agent executes an external action. Signed grant mode: required. Anonymous calls are evaluation-only and never grant ALLOW. An API key authenticates the integration; it is not principal delegation. In required mode, missing grants return GRANT_REQUIRED. An invalid deployment policy returns GRANT_POLICY_MISCONFIGURED; the operator must repair configuration. The principal owner generates an ES256 key outside the agent. Ask the operator to register only its public JWK under the principal id in VIZIER_PRINCIPAL_KEYS; check /docs delegation.princip

Default false. +not_checked, +`not_found` = looked up and nothing exists; `not_checked` = declined before a verdict (no identifier in the reference, a container-only identifier, or too sparse to check) — tell the user those were NOT verified rather than treating them as suspect. checkRetraction: description -For multi-paper bibliography audits (clinical guidelines, +To check a WHOLE reference list for retractions (e.g. 'check all these citations for retractions' at the end of a literature review, a guideline or a -reviews), loop +review), use auditBibliography instead — -per identifier — the tool intentionally rejects batch input to keep retraction-status results unambiguous per work. +runs the retraction check plus the fabrication check on up to 25 entries. +for a handful of papers -identifier for multiple papers. +identifier, for a bibliography use auditBibliography. -No sibling tool overlaps t verifyCitation: inputSchema parameters: +input.semanticTitle input.semanticTitle description: Opt-in semantic title check (any tier). On a string-level matched verdict, a calibrated model judgment of whether the claimed and resolved titles describe the same work; catches one-word swaps in long titles that string similarity misses. A flagged title moves matched → ambiguous (review), never mismatch. Not byte-deterministic — _provenance.semantic_title carries the probability. Default false.

entry.content: apply_ifc_rules: description +ONLY EQUIPMENT THAT MOVES THE AIR gets one of them: a unit is a box with a fan in it. Heating and cooling coils, heat exchangers, filters, silencers, dampers, fire dampers, VAV boxes, humidifiers are NOT units: the air runs through them, they are pieces of the network. Give them another role (coil, silencer, damper...) or none - never one of the two unit roles.
